entry.title: New: whale-on-desk
entry.summary: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client. Exact install spec: github:cookiesheep/whale-on-desk. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
